title: BeginLogin
description:
`POST /auth/login` request: begin a tenant human SSO login.

The route key is pre-login routing context only; it never becomes tenant authority. The BFF sends the SHA-256 of its random browser flow id, and the completed session is later redeemed only by that binding.

browser_flow_hash.description: SHA-256 of the BFF's random browser flow id.

tenant_route_key.description: The tenant's route key (its slug), as in `/t/{tenantKey}/login`.

Sha256Hex.description: SHA-256 digest as exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

TenantSlug.description: Human-visible tenant slug resolved to a DataTenantId at the auth boundary.
